links.outcome: Availability of workplace LLM guidelines reported by clinicians amid frequent LLM use
links.effect: 225 (32.8%) reported frequent LLM use, while only 42 (6%) reported availability of workplace LLM guidelines.
links.quote: Among 685 participants (response rate 29.0%), 225 (32.8%) reported frequent use of LLMs, 25 (3.6%) reported having used a specific medical LLM and 42 (6%) reported the availability of workplace LLM guidelines.

screen.reason: Cross-sectional survey of clinicians assessing current use, knowledge, perceptions, and availability of workplace guidelines for large language models.
